The Old Lighthouse Reopens After Two Years of Renovation

By the Harbour desk · November 15, 2026

The lighthouse on the east mole opened its door to visitors again on Saturday, after two years of scaffolding. The stair has new steps, the lamp room a glass floor, and the keeper's log from 1911 is on display in the base.

Tickets are sold at the door for six euros. The light itself is still switched on every evening at dusk.
